salient_findings: Dark brown longitudinal pigment band on the toenail
Nail thickening over the pigmented band
Pigment extending to the proximal nail fold
key_facts: New pigmented lesion on the left second toenail
Lesion first appeared 12 months before presentation
Lesion was progressively growing
Asymptomatic
No prior treatments attempted
Otherwise well
Denied fevers or weight loss
Nail thickening over the pigmented band
Pigment was the same width throughout the band
No other nail or skin lesions found

shortlist.label: Melanonychia
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive pigmented nail lesion with nail thickening

shortlist.label: Subungual melanoma
shortlist.why_kept: New pigmented lesion on the toenail with progressive growth

shortlist.label: Onychomatricoma
shortlist.why_kept: Nail thickening over the pigmented band and villous fibroepithelial projections

shortlist.label: Nail matrix nevus
shortlist.why_kept: Pigmented lesion with corresponding nail thickening and no other skin lesions

shortlist.label: Subungual hematoma
shortlist.why_kept: Dark brown longitudinal pigment band with intracorneal hemorrhage

raw.rationale: The histopathologic examination showing bland spindle cell proliferation within the nail matrix and villous fibroepithelial projections into the nail plate without melanocytic proliferation or keratinocyte atypia supports the diagnosis of onychomatricoma.

rejected.label: Melanonychia
rejected.why: No melanocytic lesions were observed on histopathologic examination

rejected.label: Subungual melanoma
rejected.why: No melanocytic proliferation was observed and immunostaining was negative for S100

rejected.label: Nail matrix nevus
rejected.why: Histopathologic examination did not show melanocytic lesions

rejected.label: Subungual hematoma
rejected.why: The presence of a progressively growing pigmented lesion and corresponding nail thickening is not typical of a subungual hematoma
